title: Groundwater purpose acceptance authority reconciliation after C4T

application_accuracy_contract.role: Carries externally qualified groundwater-head or drawdown application requirement H_app and independently qualified temporal allocation A_temporal; contains no positive numeric default.

application_accuracy_adapter.role: Transports only already validated and externally source-verified policy into the runtime contract; it does not select policy.

groundwater_accuracy_binding.role: Allocates an externally governed head-domain budget into groundwater interface tolerance while rejecting over-allocation.

groundwater_response_sensitivity.role: Optional provenance-bound local groundwater response derivative dh_groundwater/dq_groundwater for an exact trial/window; unavailable or nonsmooth response fails closed.

F_GC13.qualified_capability: Reusable project accuracy evidence ingestion and governance template.
hard_nonclaims: no real project H_app is qualified
no real project A_temporal is qualified
no direct real-project temporal head-error budget is qualified
synthetic fixture values are not project defaults
no universal application-accuracy rule is established

F_GC14.qualified_capability: Typed external accuracy packet to runtime contract adapter boundary.
hard_nonclaims: no real project H_app is qualified
no real project A_temporal is qualified
no real project direct temporal head-error budget is qualified
adapter does not select or derive project policy

F_GC29.role: Response-sensitivity transport only, not an accuracy policy source.

current_evidence.c4r: Blind comparator-relative fixed-water-table fidelity frontier replicated.
current_evidence.c4s: Full same-workload CoRichards common cohort available.
current_evidence.c4t: Shared-host purpose-dependent relative cost-fidelity signal resolved.
current_evidence.limitation: All three are relative scientific/computational evidence. None supplies an externally governed application consequence threshold.

why_no_route_can_be_selected_yet: C4T frontier membership only establishes nondominance in relative cost versus fidelity space.
LARE R3 through R8 trade cost against different error vectors; a Pareto frontier does not identify which errors are acceptable for an actual groundwater decision.
C4R/C4T observed errors cannot be reused as acceptance thresholds because that would select the envelope after inspecting the candidate result.
Reference numerical floors and solver convergence tolerances are numerical-quality controls, not application prediction-accuracy requirements.

LHM/NHI observational validation or calibration criteria are not automatically eligible substitutes for a coupling prediction-error budget; F-GC13 explicitly rejects calibration-metric substitution unless a project authority separately governs an explicit application prediction-error rule.

application_claim.required: Explicit numerical prediction-error acceptance requirement H_app for the declared real application.
scope_required: whether requirement is absolute head, drawdown, or both
application_claim.provenance: Immutable source identity and source-byte digest verified outside the kernel.

temporal_claim.required: Independent temporal allocation A_temporal in (0,1] or an explicit direct temporal head-error budget <= H_app.
temporal_claim.provenance: Distinct claim and provenance identity; source-byte digest verified.

optional_decision_consequence_claim.purpose: Can directly define a stricter application threshold if a decision class/trigger changes below the broader head-error requirement.
optional_decision_consequence_claim.requirement: Must be explicit external application authority, not inferred from ROM results.

structural_requirements: fail closed outside qualified representation/application domain

procedure: Use the actual coupling window and actual groundwater service/provider.

For each accepted provenance-matching window where F-GC29 response sensitivity is available and smooth, propagate the ROM-induced bottom-flux perturbation into a local groundwater-head/drawdown consequence using the admitted response derivative.
Evaluate the head/drawdown consequence against the externally qualified temporal/interface allocation, while separately retaining flux sign and reversal timing diagnostics.
If response sensitivity is unavailable, nonsmooth or nonfinite, fail closed or execute the actual coupled counterfactual; do not invent a linear response.
GW_D.local_linear_relation: delta_h approximately (dh_groundwater/dq_groundwater) * delta_q for the exact admitted local trial/window only.
GW_D.nonclaim: The derivative is not a global seasonal transfer function.

GW_R.objective: Regional groundwater coupling focused on coupling-interval exchange and longer-horizon bias.
procedure: Aggregate recharge/capillary exchange at the real application coupling interval.
Propagate the ROM-versus-reference exchange perturbation through the admitted downstream groundwater model or another independently qualified response operator over the declared application horizon.
Compare resulting head/drawdown consequences with the externally qualified application requirement.
Report systematic signed exchange bias separately so compensating errors cannot create false acceptance.
GW_R.nonclaim: A single instantaneous dh/dq derivative is insufficient to establish a weekly/seasonal acceptance envelope.

explicitly_not_authorized_as_numeric_env: F-GC13 synthetic 8 cm, 10 cm, 0.25, 0.2 or 2 cm fixtures
C4R or C4T observed error magnitudes
generic LHM/NHI calibration or observation-fit criteria without an explicit project prediction-error acceptance rule and provenance

missing: real externally governed groundwater application accuracy requirement H_app
independently governed temporal allocation A_temporal or direct temporal budget
verified immutable source provenance for both claims

next_when_unblocked: Instantiate the existing F-GC13/F-GC14 evidence boundary for the target project, then preregister a GW-R and/or GW-D downstream-consequence validation using the frozen C4R/C4T LARE candidates.
